name: gsd-ollama
description: Get Shit Done with Ollama - Spec-driven development system using local LLM

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && ./venv/bin/pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-mock httpx requests
scripts.install:playwright: cd frontend && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:backend:e2e && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run test:backend:e2e && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e:fullstack
scripts.test:e2e:fullstack: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/full-workflow.spec.ts
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend
scripts.clean:backend: cd backend && rm -rf __pycache__ .pytest_cache htmlcov .coverage && find . -type d -name __pycache__ -exec rm -r {} + 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:frontend: cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules dist .vite test-results playwright-report
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run install:playwright
scripts.setup:frontend: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:playwright
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:backend:unit
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run test

author: GSD Ollama Contributors
